subject: [RFC PATCH v2 14/18] mm/filemap: read large folios without folio references

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's filemap module to allow reading large folios without creating a reference to them. A large folio is one that spans all or none of its range, and once the last page in its range is reached, subsequent pages can be copied from the same folio. The patch introduces a new function `filemap_read_rcu_size` to calculate how much data can be copied from a folio without creating a reference. It also updates the `filemap_read_rcu_lookup` function to handle large folios and split them correctly when necessary. This change aims to improve performance by reducing the number of references created during file I/O operations.
